The '''Royal School of Leadership''' was a school located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rutan/Legends|Rutan]]. Sometime in [[44 BBY/Legends|44 BBY]], [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Taroon (Rutanian)|Taroon]] attended the school and was considered quite popular among the students.<ref name="TSP">''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Shattered Peace]]''</ref>
